definition: [ רָתַח ] verb boil (Late Hebrew id. ; Eccl 43:3 Hiph`il make hot ; Aramaic רְתַח , boil ); — Pi`el Imperative masculine singular רַתַּח causative Ezek 24:5 cause to boil , bring to boiling, with accusative of thing. Pu`al Perfect 3 plural רֻתְּחוּ Job 30:27 my bowels have been made to boil without quiet (figurative of violent emotion). Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine singular יַרְתִּיחַ כַּסּיר מְצוּלָה Job 41:23 he (the crocodile) maketh the depth boil like the pot. .
